title: Kymenlaakso: 4.2 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €185,650 a year
markdown:
# Kymenlaakso: 4.2 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €185,650 a year

> Closes 4.2 of 9.1 missing patients a year (46%) · €185,650 of €1.00M · €814,350 left: nothing else pays off at these assumptions

## The gap

Of 100 lung cancer patients in Kymenlaakso, 19 get treatment that aims to cure. In Finland it is 27. That is about 9 patients a year. [^care_curative] Compared with the best quarter of counties, about 13.1 patients a year are missing from treatment that aims to cure (range 9.0–16.7). [^care_curative] [^model] Compared with Finland as a whole, the shortfall splits into 7.3 fewer patients operated and 1.8 fewer given radiotherapy that aims to cure each year. [^model]

## The target

Raise the share of lung cancer patients treated to cure from 19.3% to 22.8% by 2028: 4.2 more patients a year (range 0.0–6.1), for €185,650 a year, about €44,627 per extra patient. [^care_curative][^model] That closes 46% of the measured shortfall against Finland as a whole (9.1 patients a year). [^model]

## Funded actions

| # | Action and owner | Cost a year | More patients treated to cure a year (range) | First step this week | Measure: today → target |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | **The county can start on Monday** | | | | |
| 1 | **Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated**[^ev_sbrt_pathway_1]. Chief physician of oncology; chief of radiotherapy at the university hospital | €25,640 | 1.0 (0.0–1.9) | Write the referral rule: every stage I patient not accepted for surgery is referred for stereotactic radiotherapy the same week. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 19.3% → 20.1% by 2028 |
| 2 | **Travel and hotel paid for patients far from the university hospital**[^ev_travel_accommodation_support_1]. Chief physician of oncology and hospital social work; university hospital patient hotel | €36,460 | 0.4 (0.0–0.4) | Name one contact person who books the patient hotel and transport for every patient sent to the university hospital for curative treatment. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 19.3% → 19.7% by 2028 |
| 3 | **Fitness test and training before anyone is ruled too frail for curative treatment**[^ev_prehab_fitness_assessment_1]. Chief physician of pulmonology; leads of rehabilitation and geriatrics | €31,550 | 0.3 (0.0–0.2) | Decide that no stage I-III patient is recorded as "not fit" without an exercise test, and book the physiotherapy group. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 19.3% → 19.5% by 2028 |
| | **Needs the collaborative area (university hospital)** | | | | |
| 4 | **A chest surgeon reviews every decision not to operate**[^ev_surgeon_second_opinion_1]. Chief physician of pulmonology; chief of thoracic surgery at the university hospital | €41,000 | 1.4 (0.0–2.8) | Agree with the university hospital that a thoracic surgeon joins the weekly lung meeting, and send last quarter's stage I-II patients who were not operated for a second look. | Share of patients operated: 8.8% → 10.0% by 2028 |
| 5 | **Weekly video review of every stage I-III patient with the university hospital's specialists**[^ev_video_mdt_stage1_3_1]. Chief physician of pulmonology; lead of the university hospital lung MDT | €51,000 | 1.1 (0.0–1.2) | Ask the university hospital for a fixed weekly video slot and list every stage I-III patient diagnosed last month who was not discussed there. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 19.3% → 20.3% by 2028 |
| | **Total** | **€185,650** | **4.2 (0.0–6.1)** | | |

No trial has measured these effects; the low end of every range is zero. The ranges do not add up to the range of the total, because the measures share one ceiling. Costs are assumptions. [^model]

## Needs a national decision (outside this budget)

- **Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers**[^ev_ldct_screening_1]: Ministry of Social Affairs and Health and Palko (decision), Finnish Cancer Registry (steering), county (delivery). €488,594 a year; modelled to avoid 0.8 deaths a year (0.2–2.1). Not counted in this budget. Not a county decision. Ask the Ministry and Palko for the timetable after the 2026-2028 pilot and offer the county as a pilot site. [^model]

## What to measure from Monday

- Share of patients treated to cure: 19.3% (2019–2023, measured) → 22.8% by 2028. [^care_curative][^model]
- Share of patients operated: 8.8% → 10.0% by 2028. [^care_surgery][^model]
- The registry's public figures cover 2019–2023; count these each month from the county's own records. [^care_curative]

## What more money buys, and what it cannot

€185,650 a year buys every measure that adds patients treated to cure in Kymenlaakso. [^model] In the model, the remaining €814,350 buys nothing more, because the reachable part of the shortfall limits these measures, not money. [^model] Other uses for the money are low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers, which needs a national decision, or ranking measures by deaths avoided instead. [^model] Lung cancer causes about 95 deaths a year in Kymenlaakso, and this plan is modelled to avoid 0.6 of them (range 0.0–1.8). [^deaths] [^model]

## Pilot ask

Six months with Kymenlaakso and its university hospital: ask what already runs, check 50 charts, then start the two actions that turn out to be new. In week 1, take the stored web-check questions to the university hospital. In weeks 1–8 spend €8,000 auditing 50 charts for stage, fitness, biomarker testing, why curative treatment was not given and where treatment happened. In months 3–6, start the two actions the audit says are new. Success is counted in charts audited, decisions reviewed, decisions changed and referrals made; patients moved are a secondary model estimate. [^model]

## Limits

- Effect ranges are not probabilities. They run from every assumption at its lowest to every assumption at its highest, and no trial has measured these effects. [^model]
- Shares are adjusted only for residents' age, not for stage, other illness, histology, smoking or completeness of recording. County figures cannot show cause. [^model]
- In a county-level check, 0 of 3 outcomes matched the estimated symptom-to-treatment clock beyond chance. [^model]

ask_first.question_en: Is every stage I patient from Kymenlaakso who is not accepted for surgery already referred for precise radiotherapy?
ask_first.question_fi: Lähetetäänkö jokainen leikkauksesta hylätty I-asteen potilas jo täsmäsädehoidon arvioon?

ask_first.question_en: Is every stage I–III patient from Kymenlaakso discussed with the university hospital team before a curative decision?
ask_first.question_fi: Käsitelläänkö jokainen I–III-asteen potilas jo yliopistosairaalan työryhmässä ennen parantavasta hoidosta luopumista?

ask_first.question_en: Does the university hospital book transport, accommodation and a named contact for Kymenlaakso patients who travel for curative treatment?
ask_first.question_fi: Varaako yliopistosairaala jo kuljetuksen, majoituksen ja yhteyshenkilön kauas matkustaville potilaille?

pilot.comparison_en: Vantaa and Kerava is the comparison because it has Finland's highest recorded curative share (35.6%): a reachable level, not a causal control.
pilot.comparison_fi: Vantaa ja Kerava on vertailu, koska siellä kirjattu parantavan hoidon osuus on Suomen korkein (35,6 %): tavoiteltava taso, ei kausaalinen verrokki.
pilot.targets_en: Start the two actions the audit says are new: a chest surgeon reviews every decision not to operate, and every patient who cannot be operated is referred for precise radiotherapy.
pilot.targets_fi: Käynnistetään ne kaksi toimea, jotka tarkistus osoittaa uusiksi: rintaelinkirurgi arvioi jokaisen päätöksen jättää leikkaamatta, ja jokainen potilas, jota ei voida leikata, lähetetään täsmäsädehoidon arvioon.
pilot.text_en: Six months with Kymenlaakso and its university hospital: ask what already runs, check 50 charts, then start the two actions that turn out to be new. In week 1, take the stored web-check questions to the university hospital. In weeks 1–8 spend €8,000 auditing 50 charts for stage, fitness, biomarker testing, why curative treatment was not given and where treatment happened. In months 3–6, start the two actions the audit says are new. Success is counted in charts audited, decisions reviewed, decisions changed and referrals made; patients moved are a secondary model estimate.
pilot.text_fi: Kuusi kuukautta Kymenlaakson hyvinvointialueen ja sen yliopistosairaalan kanssa: kysytään, mikä on jo käytössä, tarkistetaan 50 potilaskertomusta ja käynnistetään ne kaksi toimea, jotka osoittautuvat uusiksi. Viikolla 1 viedään tallennetuista verkkotarkistuksista saadut kysymykset yliopistosairaalaan. Viikoilla 1–8 käytetään 8 000 euroa 50 potilaskertomuksen tarkistukseen: levinneisyysaste, toimintakyky, biomarkkerit, miksi parantavaa hoitoa ei annettu ja missä hoito annettiin. Kuukausina 3–6 käynnistetään kaksi toimea sen mukaan, mitä tarkistus osoittaa. Onnistuminen lasketaan tarkistetuista kertomuksista, arvioiduista päätöksistä, muuttuneista päätöksistä ja lähetteistä; potilassiirtymät ovat toissijainen malliarvio.
pilot.cannot_show_en: 21.3% is the model's estimate for these two actions by 2028, not a measurement. The pilot is judged on the work counted, not on a promised change in the county's share.
pilot.cannot_show_fi: 21,3 % on mallin arvio näistä kahdesta toimesta vuoteen 2028 mennessä, ei mittaus. Pilottia arvioidaan lasketun työn perusteella, ei luvatun osuuden muutoksen perusteella.
